exposure: Use of complementary and alternative medicines (CAMs) during breastfeeding
cohort: 233 lactating women with no previous live children residing in Tuscany, Italy
finding: While cesarean birth was more frequent among women with a history of pregnancy loss, breastfeeding behaviors were similar between those with and without previous loss, but CAM use, particularly herbal preparations, was more common in the former group.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was significantly more frequent among women with a history of pregnancy loss compared to controls (41% versus 22%; p=0.004).
